specification.title: Jobbag Restore And Insert
specification.goal: reinsert selected objects from saved stage
specification.owner_rule: The named command is a GUI/command-line action only. Call the designated implementation owner; do not create a second geometry kernel or duplicate data stores.
specification.parent_scope: File menu, native Open/Save, Import .3dm action, Job Bags/Project Manager

api_contract.input: Typed command/document/geometry data and any selection or builder parameters required by this feature.
api_contract.output: Validated operation result and observable document changes; never silently claim success.
api_contract.edge_cases: Invalid/empty geometry, cancellation and tolerance/pathological input must be handled explicitly.
api_contract.integration: Register one capability owner; adapters dispatch to owning kernel/domain service.

acceptance_tests_auto: Automated: valid input exercises “Jobbag Restore And Insert” without panic, leaked handle or stale scene reference.
Automated: invalid, empty, or degenerate input yields an explicit error and leaves document state consistent.
Automated: each operation changes only its documented state and supports undo/cancel where applicable.
acceptance_tests_manual: Manual gate M01: run OpenMatrix9 UI; perform “Jobbag Restore And Insert”; observe preview/feedback and commit/cancel behavior.
A visible failure/warning must be shown for unsupported input; the command must never silently do nothing.
invariants: No `90-after` dependency for any M01–M09 deliverable.
No implementation may be assumed from QymCAD until source paths are checked.
Existing document IDs/layer flags/units/history remain consistent after operation.
No separate OCCT operation should be coded inside a Matrix toolbar/menu adapter.

execution_design.title: Jobbag Restore And Insert
execution_design.goal_from_canonical: reinsert selected objects from saved stage
execution_design.positive_oracle_proposed: Restore Jobbag under one transaction retaining group/layer mapping
execution_design.negative_oracle_proposed: Repeated restore must use new inserted instance IDs (unless mode replace) with no collisions
execution_design.reuse_approval_condition: Audit local checkout at pinned SHA, compile/tests, M00 human legal approval; do not infer ready from static GitHub read.
execution_design.implementation_owner_policy: One owning L2, UI modules dispatch only. No source code changes in vendor-research/ unless approved fork.
objectives: Define typed seam + explicitly testable oracle
Implement one capability at its canonical owner
Verify failure rollback, stable IDs/units/geometry as relevant

native_brep_catalog_followup_2026_11_18.scope: Canonical and native BRep Job Bags passed representative source-preserving insert, scene/pick and Undo/Redo checks; a native Box catalog reloaded and inserted through synthetic sidebar input in a separate test process. Broader dependency combinations and desktop acceptance remain open.

brep_bag_save_2026_11_18.scope: The numbered BRep v6 bag Save worker validates native packets before writing the archive. A Box bag was saved and reopened; cancel preserved an existing destination. Broader geometry, native desktop and production build remain open.

brep_jobbag_scene_worker_2026_11_18.scope: Numbered BRep Job Bag Load prepares its Paste transaction and candidate scene on a worker, then rechecks the live context and publishes one Undoable edit. Tests include a translated block, cancellation/staleness, insertion into an existing BRep scene and a 1,024-point document. Desktop responsiveness and broader geometry remain open.

jobbag_dependency_closure_2026_11_18.scope: Archive root validation accepts the exact dependency closure of selected roots and rejects unrelated extras; a clean-History MatrixApp capture/load and Undo/Redo passed. BRep paste remapping is prepared on the worker. Candidate scene, broad geometry and desktop acceptance remain open.

filtered_brep_projection_worker_2026_11_.scope: Numbered BRep Job Bag filter classification and dependency projection run on a worker; prepared results are rejected after cancellation or project/catalog changes. A translated homogeneous block, mixed-block refusal, no-match and Undo/Redo passed scoped headless tests. Paste remapping, candidate-scene preparation, large-scene latency and desktop remain open.

brep_filtered_load_2026_11_18.scope: Numbered v6 Job Bag type filtering validates original roots, expands dependencies and remaps a selected projection. A polysurface fixture preserved BRep roots, a translated homogeneous block and Undo/Redo; no-match and mixed blocks preserved state.
brep_filtered_load_2026_11_18.remaining: Projection and candidate preparation after native restore run on the UI thread. Project archive import, named snapshots, broader geometry/resource/history cases, native containment and desktop acceptance remain open. The full Projects suite did not finish.

brep_capture_load_2026_11_18.scope: Numbered Job Bag BRep capture and Load All run on workers. A command-created, moved Box survived catalog reload, source deletion, insertion into another document and Undo/Redo; canceled and stale captures left the slot unchanged.
brep_capture_load_2026_11_18.remaining: Filtered v6 Load, project archive import, named snapshots, broader geometry/dependencies, native capture containment, paired production build and desktop remain open. The full Projects suite did not finish within ten minutes.

brep_load_all_2026_11_18.scope: Experimental v6 Job Bag Load All restores on a worker, validates project/slot/selection and exact root manifest, and uses the existing dependency-remapping transaction. A two-box translated-block fixture passed Undo/Redo, cancel, stale and invalid-root checks.
brep_load_all_2026_11_18.remaining: BRep capture and v6 project import are not connected; filtered Load, named snapshots, full dependencies, native capture containment and desktop remain open.

reserved_brep_dependency_mutations_2026_.scope: Reserved BRep mutations can coexist with the non-geometry resource and metadata mutation kinds used by paste. An authored BRep plus resource payload committed in one transaction and survived Undo/Redo; a stale resource mutation refused the whole request while preserving Redo.
reserved_brep_dependency_mutations_2026_.remaining: Only the resource case has BRep integration evidence; layer, metadata and other dependency combinations need end-to-end fixtures. Published BRep history results, native payloads, archive/Job Bag integration and desktop acceptance remain open; the v5 guard remains.

exact_jobbag_root_set_2026_11_17.scope: A decoded selection archive must contain exactly the top-level roots listed in the Job Bag manifest; dependency tables remain separate. Insert, filtered insert and project import refuse extra, missing or duplicate roots before publication.
exact_jobbag_root_set_2026_11_17.remaining: BRep archive integration and desktop end-to-end acceptance remain open.

filtered_nested_instance_reload_2026_11_.scope: Filtered Load validates archived roots and can resolve a homogeneous legacy UnknownInstance from its archived definitions. An authored nested-mesh and embedded-texture fixture retained placement, remapped resources and Undo/Redo after the original root was deleted and the catalog reopened. A mismatched stored class was refused; mixed blocks and BRep archive support remain open.

filtered_bag_admission_2026_11_17.scope: Filtered insert uses configured-budget archive admission and validates snapshot roots. One 65 MiB embedded texture passed insertion and Undo/Redo at a 2 GiB configured limit; budget and invalid-root failures preserved the target.
filtered_bag_admission_2026_11_17.remaining: Physical and GPU peak, desktop filtering and broader asset types remain unverified.

native_selection_p07_2026_11_17.scope: SDK-authored point and nested mirrored instance passed insertion, Undo/Redo, 3DM publication and reimport; nested world-space point coordinates were checked. BRep and arbitrary native tables remain open.

runtime_implementation.scope: Restore a Job Bag slot as fresh IDs in one Controller transaction; repeated restores never collide.
remaining: Point, resource, nested-instance and representative canonical/native BRep cases have scoped P07 evidence; arbitrary geometry and dependencies, full native desktop workflow and visual/DPI acceptance remain open.

last_verified.note: Job Bag state embedded as .om9 resource and restored on Open; Master restore live; manual M01-UI pending.

project_manager_audit_2026_11_17.scope: Image-led Project Manager audit: eight existing integration tests pass; six model gaps reproduced; twenty gaps planned. No implementation or manual gate promotion.
